reviews.body:
Read the three changed files at `9b1d18d02f3`: the Jury docstring, the LiteLLM provider docstring, and the MLflow evaluation guide. The replacement IDs are current: `claude-sonnet-5-5` and `claude-haiku-5-5` are the Claude 5.5 family (Sonnet GA 2026-09-28, Haiku 2026-10-07), and `gemini-3.8-flash` is a current Vertex/Gemini API id. The Bedrock form `anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5` matches the model card naming.

One correction to the test claim in the description: `grep -rnE "claude-3|gemini-pro" src docs` still returns two matches, both in `src/providers/cortex/trulens/providers/cortex/config/cortex_model_costs.json`:

```text
"claude-3-5-sonnet": {"input": 1.50, "output": 7.50},
"claude-3-7-sonnet": {"input": 1.50, "output": 7.50}
```

Those look like deliberate legacy cost entries, not documentation users copy, so I would leave them. Please narrow the claim to the docstrings/docs rather than "5 matches to 0", so the PR description matches what a reviewer sees.

No code paths or defaults change; I did not run tests because the diff is docstrings/docs only. Certification is present and the AI-assistance note is in the description.

Not blocking: if you touch this again, `src/providers/litellm/.../provider.py` says "e.g." and lists one Anthropic id while the Jury example uses the Haiku id; that is fine as an example, just noting the two differ intentionally.

@feiiiiii5 verified the model IDs and caught the test-claim discrepancy. The replacements are correct: `claude-sonnet-5-5` / `claude-haiku-5-5` match current Anthropic naming, and `gemini-3.8-flash` is a current Vertex id. The Bedrock form `anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5` is consistent with Bedrock model card conventions. Docs-only change, no code paths affected. Ready to merge.
